captions.caption: A person in athletic gear is standing on top of a brick wall.
They take a deep breath and look at the path ahead.
The person starts running along the narrow top of the wall.
They jump from the wall onto a nearby metal railing.
The person balances on the railing for a split second.
They perform a precision jump from the railing to a concrete ledge.
The person rolls forward upon landing to absorb the impact.
They quickly get back up and continue running across a rooftop.
The person approaches the edge of the roof and jumps to a lower one.
They catch the edge of the lower roof and pull themselves up.
The person performs a wall run along a vertical surface.
They kick off the wall to reach a higher platform.
The person crawls through a narrow gap between two buildings.
They emerge on the other side and jump onto a dumpster.
The person uses the dumpster to spring up to a fire escape ladder.
They climb the ladder quickly, moving hand over hand.
The person reaches the first landing of the fire escape.
They jump from the fire escape onto a thick tree branch.
The person swings from the branch and drops to the ground.
They land in a crouched position and look around.
The person starts running again, heading towards a set of stairs.
They jump over the entire flight of stairs in one go.
The person performs a backflip off a small stone bench.
They land perfectly and continue their run without stopping.
The person runs towards a fence and performs a vault over it.
They land on their feet and sprint across a grassy area.
The person approaches a series of concrete bollards.
They jump from one bollard to the next with great precision.
The person reaches the last bollard and jumps to a sidewalk.
They perform a side flip over a low bush.
The person runs towards a brick building and starts to climb.
They use small crevices in the bricks to gain height.
The person reaches a window ledge and pulls themselves up.
They move horizontally along the ledge towards a pipe.
The person grabs the pipe and slides down to the ground.
They perform a roll upon hitting the pavement.
The person gets up and sprints towards a construction site.
They jump over a pile of wooden pallets.
The person runs across a narrow wooden beam.
They jump from the beam onto a stack of sandbags.
The person performs a front flip off the sandbags.
They continue running, weaving through some scaffolding.
The person slides under a low bar in the scaffolding.
They jump up and grab a horizontal bar to perform a jump.
The person lands on a distant platform.
They jump from the platform onto a hanging rope.
The person swings on the rope and jumps to a nearby wall.
They perform another wall run, this time changing direction.
The person jumps from the wall onto a metal crane arm.
They walk carefully along the crane arm, high above the ground.
The person reaches the end of the crane arm and looks down.
They perform a massive jump into a pile of loose sand.
The person emerges from the sand and shakes it off.
They start running again, heading out of the construction site.
The person jumps over a low concrete wall onto a street.
They sprint down the middle of the empty street.
The person performs a series of cartwheels on the pavement.
They stop and take a final, triumphant pose.
The person is breathing heavily but looks very happy.
The video ends with a shot of the person walking away.
